label: Pillars of Eternity II: Deadfire sandboxes
description: How Pillars of Eternity II: Deadfire sandboxes deploy, and how to find the game on this machine. Paths: vortex.

notes: The Xbox/Microsoft Store build names this folder PillarsOfEternity2_Data instead. Mod manifests are also registered in a modconfig.json under the user's LocalLow folder, which this app does not write.
Hard links are the default: the game folder and the staging folder are almost always on one drive, and nothing is copied twice when two sandboxes share a mod.
